newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 52-wk T-bills gross 11.55 pct, heavy demand.
newsitem.headline: Czech 52-wk T-bills gross 11.55 pct, heavy demand.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank Dutch auction offering five billion crowns ($171.9 million) in 52-week treasury bills was 11.55 percent, and the auction was oversubscribed with bids totalling 10.36 billion crowns.

In the last auction of similar bills in September, yield was 12.12 percent and the five billion crown offer was oversubscribed with bids totalling 12.153 billion crowns. But that was before a tax on the bills was added at the beginning of 1997.
With the tax factored in, net yield in the Thursday auction was 8.66 percent.
